title: Irodora effect-link graph
description: Recorded causal dependencies: if A changes, B must change too. Every link must name the automated guard that catches a violation — a critical link with guard 'none' fails the state gate, which turns this graph into a standing backlog of the checks we still owe. See ADR-0030.

exists.description: false when the target is planned but not yet created. The state gate skips path validation for these, and reports them so they cannot be forgotten.

scope.description: Packages, apps or areas involved. Enables cross-service effect queries.

severity.description: critical = a silent break with product-wide consequence.

guard.description: The automated check that catches a violation: 'gate:<id>', 'test:<path>', 'lint:<rule>', or 'none'. A critical link with 'none' FAILS the state gate — record the feature that will add the guard rather than downgrading the severity.

memory.description: The narrative note. The JSON says THAT B depends on A; the note says WHY, which is what lets the next person judge whether the link still holds after a redesign.

feature.description: The feature that will add the missing guard, where guard is 'none'.
